title: Zora Network - Open App
meta_description: zora network: open the official Zora app to explore an Ethereum L2 for onchain media, creator coins, NFTs and activity.
hero_lead: Zora Network is the Ethereum Layer 2 behind Zora's onchain media, NFT and coin experiences, using ETH for gas and the OP Stack for scalable creator activity.
what_is: Zora is an Ethereum Layer 2 for onchain media and creator markets; the official Zora Network docs describe it as fast, cost-efficient and built to bring media onchain.

how.d: Use the official app at zora.co, then connect a wallet only after verifying the domain.
Switch to Zora mainnet in your wallet; the network uses chain ID 7777777 and ETH for gas.
Bridge ETH only if needed through the official native bridge or another supported bridge, starting with a small test amount.
Create, collect or trade in the app, then review transactions on explorer.zora.energy.

points.p: Designed for onchain media, NFTs and creator apps, with app surfaces on Zora for creating and trading coins.
Mainnet uses ETH as gas and chain ID 7777777; confirm network data in the official network details before adding it to a wallet.
Transactions, blocks and addresses can be checked on the Zora Network explorer.

faq.a: Zora Network is an Ethereum Layer 2 built with the OP Stack for onchain media, NFTs and creator applications; see the official docs.

faq.q: Is zora network an Ethereum Layer 2?
faq.a: Yes. Official network docs list it as an L2 built on Ethereum with the OP Stack, and it uses ETH as the mainnet gas token.

faq.q: What is the zora network chain ID?
faq.a: Mainnet chain ID is 7777777; Zora Sepolia testnet is 999999999. Confirm in the network details before signing.

faq.q: Where is the official zora network app?
faq.a: Open the official app at zora.co and verify the domain before connecting a wallet.

faq.q: How do I bridge to zora network?
faq.a: The official native bridge is bridge.zora.energy; bridge a small test amount first and do not send WETH or unsupported ERC-20s to the bridge address.

footer_note: This page is not the official app; verify zora.co before connecting a wallet; educational only, not financial advice.
